data.name: Whispering Eclipsia
data.detailed_description:
"Some secrets are written in blood. Some are locked in time."

Whispering Eclipsia is a first-person psychological horror detective game developed by First Front Game Studios. Step into the shoes of Inspector Keshav as he faces the most chilling and bizarre case of his career—the mysterious 16th murder at the infamous Woodslane Bungalow.

THE STORY

Woodslane has always been quiet, until a series of gruesome, unexplained ritualistic murders shook the town. 15 bodies found. Zero leads. Now, the 16th murder has been reported. Summoned to the crime scene under heavy rain and static radio calls, Inspector Keshav's journey into the dark woods turns into a living nightmare when a devastating car accident traps him on a desolate bridge.

But death is not the end here. Time works differently in the woods. To solve the mystery and survive the night, you must navigate through fracturing realities, dark shadow entities, and choices that will alter your fate.

KEY FEATURES

  • Immersive Psychological Horror: Powered by cutting-edge audio design and a tense environment that keeps you on the edge of your seat from the very first second.

  • Choice-Driven Dialogue System: Your conversations matter. Make critical decisions under pressure that branch the narrative and change how characters react to you.

  • The Shadow Entity: You are not alone in the dark. An unseen, malicious force is stalking your every move from the shadows. Can you reveal its face before it consumes you?

  • Unravel the Mystery: Explore the terrifying lore behind the parallel loops. Find out what connects the victims, and discover what the wall truly means when it commands: "Bring Ravi & Aadi to me."

content_descriptors.notes:
Whispering Eclipsia is a psychological detective thriller that deals with dark and mature themes suitable for an adult audience. Potential players should be aware of the following:

Violence: The game contains realistic portrayals of crime scenes and investigations, including references to murder. Violence is primarily narrative-driven and essential to the detective investigation.

Sexual Violence: The storyline includes references to past instances of sexual violence as part of a character's backstory to establish motive and narrative depth. These themes are discussed through dialogue and investigation notes; there are no graphic or explicit visual depictions of sexual assault in the game.

Sensitive Themes: The narrative explores complex psychological trauma, mystery, and dark atmospheric elements.

The game is intended for players who enjoy intense, story-heavy detective mysteries. We have ensured that the mature subject matter is handled with narrative respect, focusing on the emotional weight of the mystery rather than graphic exploitation.
